nom: SUNDAY RILEY C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum

segments.sensitive: Most self-described sensitive-skin reviewers, including some who react to many new products, report no irritation or breakouts and often praise it as unusually gentle for a vitamin C serum; one reviewer with sensitive, fair skin instead reports it left her skin greasy, caused small breakouts, and left her complexion duller within weeks.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one whose dry patch under her eye finally healed after a week of use, report it adds hydration and keeps their skin from drying out even in winter.
segments.combination: The two reviewers with combination skin, one leaning dry, report smoother, more even texture and no negative reaction.

concerns.aging: A couple of reviewers say their skin looks firmer or more youthful with use, though one is uncertain whether the change is real.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers report the serum adds noticeable hydration and keeps their skin from drying out, including one whose skin stayed hydrated through a harsh winter for the first time; no reviewer in this set reports it leaving skin drier.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers report visibly reduced redness with use, including one who saw her chronic redness disappear within one bottle; none in this set report the serum causing new redness, though other vitamin C serums they had tried previously did.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report visibly lighter dark spots, sun spots, or dark circles within days to a few weeks of use; one reviewer says a cheaper alternative worked better for her hyperpigmentation than this serum did.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including some who are acne-prone, report no new breakouts and say it fades old acne marks; one reviewer instead says it caused small breakouts that were unusual for her skin.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers say the serum absorbs without feeling heavy or greasy; a couple of others describe a mild to noticeable greasy feel, with one linking it to a subsequent breakout.

aspects.libelle: Bottle appears larger than the product inside
Airless pouch keeps vitamin C stable
Expensive per ounce, runs out quickly
Texture may differ from sample size

extraits.texte: I have sensitive, fair skin and have a very in-depth skincare routine. I ran out of my vitamin C serum I got in South Korea, so I was on the lookout for a new one. I used the whole bottle, religiously putting it on every morning after my essence followed by my moisturizer then sunscreen. I wait a few minutes between putting on each product, so it sets into the skin. I notice it leaves my skin feeling a bit greasy. I started getting little breakout, which was unusual for me, then my skin looked dull a few weeks later. Once I started the TruSkin Vitamin C Sreum, after a week my skin started looking brighter again so it was definitely the CEO serum. This is not for everyone, I would use a sample size to see how your skin reacts before committing to a bigger size, especially with the price.

My skin is SO glowly! But within a month of using this I have seemed to use it ALL up?! How is that even possible?! I have other products that are the same oz. And it takes months to use it up!! So… this serum is VERY pricey for the teeny tiny amount of serum you get!! I don't know if it is worth it. I am going to go back to using Timeless Vitamin C + E Ferulic Acid Serum (which is soooooo good for the price)!!! And it worked better at helping diminish my hyperpigmentation than the Sunday Riley Vitamic C Serum did.

I loveee this product!! Of all the skincare products I actively use and have tried, this one probably has had the most visible impact on my skin. I'm in the 25-35 age range, have combination skin that leans dry, and can sometimes react to new products. I used to have a bit of an uneven skintone with a fair bit of redness (even after cutting dairy, which was a major contributor to the redness/inflamation). I first tried the less concentrated syrum version of this product and loved it enough to want the stronger option. Within one bottle my skin was quite literally smoother, had a more even texture, was brighter and no more redness! That was the first time I had honestly seen an undeniable improvement from a skincare product. It smells so nice (like oranges!) and has a wonderful smooth texture kind of like a thin lotion. It dries fast and doesn't leave any sort of sticky feeling like some vitamin c products tend to do. Out of curiosity, I took apart an empty bottle and the product is pumped from a small sealed bag which is keyyy for vitamin c. Vitamin c is unstable when exposed to air, light and heat so to maintain its effectiveness it must stay sealed and cool. I've heard that some people have a hard time with vitamin c causing a reaction but I've never had an issue with any of the products I've tried. So maybe it's just me but this hasn't bothered my skin at all. Any time I get a compliment on my skin I recommend this product and have hyped it up to all my friends lol the big

I've tried other vitamin C serums and they either smell weird, don't work, or give me huge red rashes on my face. This one works and is sensitive skin friendly! I never broke out one time. And it really makes a difference in the glow and eveness of my skin.

So this is my first winter living in the Pacific North West. In late November after a particularly cold weekend, I noticed a patch of dry skin had formed underneath my eye. It resembled a dark sun spot on my fair skin. I tried several different creams but my skin was not healing. I started applying this serum twice per day, and within a week it was finally healing. I think the spot is barely noticeable now. The skin around my eyes feels more moisturized and my dark circles aren't as bad as before. I also love the way it smells.

I received C.E.O 15% vitamin C brightening serum gifted by Sunday Riley in exchange, for my honest opinion, the packaging is simple Yet elegant , the pump dispenses the perfect amount for each use , I don't see a huge difference yet but my skin does seem a bit brighter, I have acne prone dry sensitive skin so I'm only using it a few times a week to ease my skin into it but it's has great texture and I can't wait to see results and will be repurchasing this again!

Gifted by Sunday Riley. I use this product twice a day. It's a gentle formula and I have sensitive skin. I has a refreshing citrus scent. I like using this with Good Genes All-In One Lactic Acid Treatment. This product makes my skin glow. It brightens and tightens. Would recommend!
